title: Desk Tool Card — Invoicing Analyst Overage on an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# Invoicing Analyst Overage

Desk tool card for the charge raised under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions when a building owner's analyst work has been drawn beyond the hours their subscription year includes.

## When the charge is raised

Analyst work drawn beyond the hours a subscription year includes is invoiced to the building owner as one charge on the subscription, covering the studies already delivered. The charge falls due once the delivered studies on the subscription's record have drawn hours beyond what the year includes; it is entered as a single analyst overage line for the period it covers, and from that moment it stands on the subscription's invoice history and raises the amount the subscription owes.

## The tool

`charge_analyst_overage_446fe12a` is an agent-side tool: the client services agent unlocks it and calls it, entering the charge on the owner's subscription. The office allocates the invoice number itself, so the same charge entered twice with the same details lands once.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | the reference number of the energy monitoring subscription the charge is entered on, read from the subscription lookup for this building owner | Id |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the building owner's account the charge is billed to, read from the account lookup | Id |
| `billing_period` | the period the charge covers | YYYY-MM for a monthly period, YYYY-Qn for a quarterly period, or YYYY for a whole subscription year; no other spelling is accepted and the value is never left empty |
| `due_date` | the day the invoice carrying this charge falls due, in the office's local calendar | YYYY-MM-DD, never left empty |
| `amount_usd` | the money amount of the charge in USD | positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent as it is entered |

## Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text stating the invoice number allocated to the charge (INV- followed by 8 digits), the subscription it was entered on, the period it covers and the amount billed in USD to two decimal places. Any sentence of that shape means the charge now stands on the subscription's invoice history. No other return is defined.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A charge entered for a quarterly period on a subscription with an amount of USD 1215.00 and a due date in the following month returns a sentence of the form "Analyst overage billed on INV-00000000 against subscription … for 2026-Q3: USD 1215.00."
